missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: We’ve received communication from Rebel spies aboard the Imperial frigate Rand Ecliptic. The crew has mutinied and wants to make contact. Unfortunately the Rand Ecliptic is being pursued by Imperial forces and is not close to our position. We need to intervene as quickly as possible. Maintenance is at the moment equipping your a-wings with an additional fuel tank to complete the hyperspace jump. There’s only enough fuel though to complete a one way jump. So you’ll either need to hitch a ride home with the Rand Ecliptic or jump to one of the designated safe points marked on your map. Good luck Red Squadron.
Head to the jump point and good luck Red Squadron.
There she is, the Rand Ecliptic..
Lead, I've reading an Assault Craft heading for the Rand Ecliptic. Looks like they want her back.
Well let's make sure they don't get her. Break and engage Red Squadron.
Leader. I'm reading another assault craft.
Engage the Tie Fighters at will. But don't let that transport reach the Rand Ecliptic.
Thanks for the assist Red Squadron. We're having problems with the Hyperdrive motivator. If you can cover us until it's ready. That would be greatly appreciated.
There pushing the attack. I'm reading two Assault Craft and six Ties. Hold them back Red Squadron.
This is the Rand Ecliptic. Hyperdrive active. Getting ready to jump.
Acknowledged Rand Ecliptic. Mind if we get a lift?
Not at all Red Squadron. Recommend you land immediately.
Red Squadron, make a b-line for the Rand Ecliptic. This party's over.

Thanks for the help Red Squadron. With your assistance we were able to shake off our pursuers and make the jump to hyperspace. Get some well earned rest, if everything goes smoothly we’ll be reaching the fleet in two days…
TGS - M05 Ambush in the Cron Drift
